providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): same single-flyby limitation as Pluto's other small moons — shape and rough dimensions known from New Horizons, but no controlled global mosaic exists. Procedural texture: bright neutral base with light cratering, same treatment as its 3 sibling small moons (real >50% albedo, water-ice composition).
